modelingNotes: Historical manufacturer catalog explicitly prints ZB4-BV033. Current Schneider product datasheet dated 11 Sept 2026 uses ZB4BV033 for the green plain-lens 22 mm head, 0.026 kg.
Mechanical head only. No light block, contact block, transformer or mounting body is modeled as included.

Exact product sheet: https://www.se.com/in/en/product/download-pdf/ZB4BV033 ; p.1 identifies the head and chromium-plated metal bezel; p.4 shows dimensions; pp.9-11 show compatible electrical compositions, not head terminals.
Zero documented electrical terminals, functions or factory links. No voltage/current rating is assigned to this head. LED-body compatibility does not specify an installed supply voltage.
Metal head attachment and protective bonding remain undocumented by the reviewed sources. No PE terminal, panel bond or collar continuity is inferred. Accessory/documentation rendering only.

connectionCoverage.notes: Head-only scope verified; zero documented electrical terminals. Evidence does not establish the metal head's bonding/attachment interface or exhaustive absence of conductive interfaces. Separately ordered light/body terminals are outside this type.
